findings.basis: The source is one file: Motorola's carrier config as imported into LineageOS's android_device_motorola_lyriq (commit title names stock build V1TLS35.73-60-3-14). 2026-10-24 is the import date; the value's own age is not known, and stock itself was not read. Each listed block states the value explicitly for its exact network code and GID. Blocks 730, 731. Samsung names this GID (BA0162) on 311-480 only; Motorola lists it on all three Verizon codes, and Google's list carries its other Verizon GIDs across the same codes. Against the Google lane's verizon_us value the 11 entries differ in two places: they add '333|unallocated (unassigned) number|337' and drop '510|Call Completion Elsewhere|1014'. The other ten are on both sides. The same 11 entries stand in the plain 311-480 block of lyriq and of android_device_motorola_sm7250-common (2021), and read 3276e7f0ff2c passed this value for gid1 BA0012 on 311-480. These profiles have no recorded source family, so no read can admit them: no served item results (see unrecorded_basis in docs/ocd-dataset.md).
findings.effect: ims_reasoninfo_mapping_string_array (CarrierConfigManager.java:2827-2828, default null at :12152) is read only by ImsPhoneCallTracker, which parses each 'FROM|MESSAGE|TO' entry, lower-cases the message and matches by code and message prefix (ImsPhoneCallTracker.java:2020-2064, 3226-3295, 1205-1250). maybeRemapReasonCode feeds getDisconnectCauseFromReasonInfo (3298-3353). The ImsStack and its ocd fork do not read the key. The extra message is the Reason text, and a Q.850 reason arrives prefixed 'q.850;' so a plain entry does not match it (CallReasonInfo.h:325-354, carrier_config.xml:314). The key read 6dc7fbef894f names the four ways a mapped code reaches emergency handling: a target or source of 363 or 364, a target of 501, 111 or 1500, a target of 143, 1017 or 1404, and a target of 1501. An emergency INVITE failure normally reaches the framework as CS retry 146 with an empty message (EmergencyStartErrorHandler.cpp:72-141), and, by that read, redial decisions use the raw code. On a phone: admitted only for the most specific profile that sets the key, else the Google-lane value (Serving.kt:405-440).
findings.risk: As for the same value on 311-480: labels only. No item is served, so these SIMs keep the Google-lane verizon_us value.
